name: crawldata
description: Desktop media tools for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest
author: Quang Ny

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:8695 tcp:8696 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:vite" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-yt-dlp.cjs mac && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-yt-dlp.cjs win && node scripts/prepare-windows-native.cjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-yt-dlp.cjs mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-yt-dlp.cjs win && node scripts/prepare-windows-native.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac: node scripts/verify-mac-signing.cjs && npm run build && node scripts/prepare-yt-dlp.cjs mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --config.mac.notarize=true --publish always
scripts.release:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-yt-dlp.cjs win && node scripts/prepare-windows-native.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish always
